notices.text: The grant period is 12 months. Payments are made on a reimbursement basis: grantees submit monthly invoices, and the Foundation pays approved invoices within 45 days. A 25% cash match of the total project cost is required. Indirect costs may not exceed 8% of direct costs. Grantees submit a mid-year report and a final report. The grantee must hire a full-time project coordinator within 60 days of the award.

Grants are paid in two installments: 50% of the award is paid in advance when the agreement is signed, and the remaining 50% after the funder approves the final report. No matching funds are required. Indirect costs of up to 15% of the total award are allowed. Grantees submit one final report at the end of the 12-month grant period.
Matching funds are strongly encouraged but not required. Grantees are paid in arrears after expenses are documented. Reports are due as requested by the program officer.
The Fund supports summer reading programs for children in grades K-3 in Vermont. Applicants must be 501(c)(3) organizations with at least two years of programming.
